proseSlots.hint: The 2ε and 2δ bands. Each is a horizontal or vertical strip on the Cartesian plane. The function enters the ε-band whenever x stays inside the δ-band. Name the bands; do not derive ε-δ formally here.
Animate shrinking δ. As δ halves, ε must follow. Show the learner the live relationship: a tighter δ forces a tighter ε, and the learner must see the graph stay inside the ε-band the whole time.

Side-by-side: the 'close enough on x' half-strip vs the 'close enough on y' half-strip. The names are the same but the roles differ — one controls where x can be, the other where f(x) is allowed to land.
